worker_count.description: Number of worker processes for the Octavia worker service.

api_worker_count.description: Number of API worker processes to handle incoming REST requests.

log_dir.description: Directory where Octavia worker logs are written.

log_file.description: Filename for the main worker log file (appended to log_dir).

verbose_logging.description: Enable verbose logging (more detailed output at INFO level).

audit_logging_enabled.description: Enable audit logging for compliance and forensic analysis.

healthcheck_port.description: Port for the internal health check listener (used by load balancers to detect service status).

healthcheck_host.description: IP address the health check listener binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only).

provider_driver.description: Provider driver (e.g., 'amphora' for amphora-based load balancing, 'ovn' for OVN-based).

health_heartbeat_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between health check heartbeats to amphorae.

health_heartbeat_timeout.description: How long to wait for an amphora heartbeat before marking it as failed.

health_update_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between health status syncs with the database.

controller_heartbeat.description: Interval (seconds) between controller heartbeats for self-monitoring.

amp_failover_heartbeat_threshold.description: Number of missed heartbeats before an amphora is marked dead and triggered for failover.

db_connection.description: Database connection string (SQLAlchemy URI) for the Octavia database.

db_max_retries.description: Maximum number of database connection retries (set to -1 for infinite).

rpc_topic.description: RabbitMQ topic used for RPC communication with controllers and amphorae.

notification_driver.description: Notification driver for publishing lifecycle events (e.g., 'messagingv2').

notify_on_changes.description: Event types to publish (comma-separated: error, warning, info, debug, or 'all').

rpc_callback_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for RPC callbacks (e.g., responses from the controller).

keystone_auth_url.description: Keystone endpoint URL for service authentication.

keystone_project_domain.description: Keystone project domain name for the Octavia service account.

keystone_project_name.description: Keystone project (tenant) name where Octavia service account resides.

keystone_username.description: Keystone username for the Octavia service account.

keystone_password.description: Password for the Octavia service account in Keystone (leave blank in secure deployments; use secrets management).

keystone_insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for Keystone (not recommended for production).

ca_certificate_path.description: Path to the CA certificate used to verify amphora certificates.

server_certificate_path.description: Path to the server certificate for amphora-to-worker communication.

server_private_key_path.description: Path to the private key for the server certificate.

cert_expiry_warning_days.description: Days before certificate expiry to trigger warnings in logs.

concurrent_process_group.description: Number of concurrent amphora provisioning/deletion operations (per worker).

amp_boot_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for amphora instance boot before marking as failed.

amp_image_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for building an amphora image (e.g., from Glance).

amp_image_retry_interval.description: Minimum interval (seconds) between amphora image build retries.

amp_threads.description: Number of worker threads for background tasks (e.g., health update batching).

pool_size.description: Size of the thread pool for handling concurrent tasks.

client_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for amphora API client calls.

service_auth_type.description: Authentication type for service-to-service calls (e.g., to Nova, Neutron).

service_project_name.description: Project (tenant) name used for service-to-service auth.

service_password.description: Password for service-to-service authentication (use secrets in production).

service_insecure.description: Disable TLS verification for service-to-service calls (testing only).

amphora_network.description: Neutron network name for amphora management traffic.

amphora_subnet.description: Neutron subnet name for amphora management traffic.

amp_floating_ip_pool.description: Neutron floating IP pool name for amphora public access (leave blank if not used).

amphora_security_groups.description: List of security group names/IDs to apply to amphora management interfaces.

ha_network_id.description: UUID of HA network for active/standby amphorae (optional; auto-generated if blank).

ha_network_name.description: Name of HA network (used if ha_network_id is blank).

ha_subnet_id.description: UUID of HA subnet for active/standby amphorae (optional).

ha_subnet_name.description: Name of HA subnet (used if ha_subnet_id is blank).

compute_driver.description: Compute driver used for amphora provisioning (e.g., 'nova').

vithoria_enabled.description: Enable the Vithoria plugin for advanced Octavia features (e.g., SNI, TLS passthrough).

vithoria_url.description: URL of the Vithoria plugin endpoint.

vithoria_token.description: Authentication token for the Vithoria plugin (use secrets management in production).
